lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4N4O4 (reduced formula CeNO) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group P4/nmm (No. 129), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Ce centers with 8 geometric neighbors (4 N, 4 O) and N centers with 9 neighbors, while O centers display either 6- or 4-coordinate environments. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner, edge, and face contacts among Ce and O polyhedra and corner sharing between Ce and N polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
